title: A Coordinated Implementation Roadmap for the Transition to Post-Quantum Cryptography
summary: Roadmap published via the European Commission setting out recommendations Member States need to implement for a synchronised transition to post-quantum cryptography, with measures to ensure coordination.

title: Commission Recommendation (EU) 2024/1101 on a Coordinated Implementation Roadmap for the transition to Post-Quantum Cryptography
summary: Official EUR-Lex text of Commission Recommendation (EU) 2024/1101 of 11 April 2024 on a Coordinated Implementation Roadmap for the transition to Post-Quantum Cryptography.

title: EU reinforces its cybersecurity with post-quantum cryptography
summary: European Commission news item presenting post-quantum cryptography, based on encryption methods using complex mathematical problems, as an effective solution to quantum-era security challenges.

title: Commission publishes Recommendation on Post-Quantum Cryptography
summary: News announcement of the Commission Recommendation on Post-Quantum Cryptography, encouraging Member States to develop and implement a harmonised approach.

title: Survey - EU Roadmap on Post-Quantum Cryptography
summary: Commission notice of a stakeholder survey supporting the EU Roadmap on Post-Quantum Cryptography, framed by the cryptographic threats posed by quantum computing.

title: European Commission welcomes G7 cybersecurity declaration to strengthen global digital resilience
summary: Commission news item welcoming a G7 cybersecurity declaration that calls for coordinated action across industry on Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC) migration.

title: Post-Quantum Cryptography: Current state and quantum mitigation
summary: ENISA study providing an overview of the current state of the standardisation process for Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC).

title: Post-Quantum Cryptography: Anticipating Threats and Preparing the Future
summary: ENISA news item stressing that the transition to post-quantum cryptography does not end with the selection and standardisation of post-quantum algorithms.

title: Engineering Data Protection in the wake of PQC
summary: ENISA webinar discussing the latest developments and considerations on engineering personal data protection in the post-quantum cryptography context.

title: Post-Quantum Cryptography - Integration study
summary: ENISA report exploring the necessity to design new cryptographic protocols and integrate post-quantum systems into existing protocols.

title: Solving the cryptography riddle: Post-quantum computing and crypto-assets blockchain puzzles
summary: ENISA news item announcing the release of two cryptography reports, one of them on the progress of post-quantum cryptography standardisation.

title: Cryptographic security: A question for Europe's digital sovereignty
summary: European Parliamentary Research Service briefing on cryptographic security and digital sovereignty, covering international post-quantum cryptography efforts including national PQC standard-selection competitions.

title: Resolution on the EU's Cybersecurity Strategy for the Digital Decade (procedure summary)
summary: Summary of the European Parliament resolution on the EU's Cybersecurity Strategy for the Digital Decade, calling for further research into post-quantum algorithms as a standard for cybersecurity.

title: Quantum technologies: Can they boost the EU's decarbonisation?
summary: European Parliamentary Research Service briefing on quantum technologies that identifies post-quantum cryptography (PQC) as the near-to-medium-term priority, as presented in the Commission's roadmap.

title: Quantum Europe Strategy
summary: The Quantum Europe Strategy (July 2025), which references a cryptography roadmap specifying quantum-safe algorithms alongside quantum communication, sensing and computing objectives. PDF hosted on the Quantum Flagship (qt.eu) site rather than an europa.eu domain.

title: ETSI launches new standard for Quantum-Safe Hybrid Key Exchanges
summary: ETSI press release announcing a new standard for Quantum-Safe Hybrid Key Exchanges to secure future post-quantum encryption.

title: ETSI/IQC Quantum Safe Cryptography Conference 2026
summary: Event page for the ETSI/IQC Quantum Safe Cryptography Conference 2026, covering quantum-safe technologies from post-quantum algorithms and quantum key distribution to hardware security modules.

title: ETSI/IQC conference: Migrate now to post-quantum cryptography!
summary: ETSI press release stating that post-quantum cryptography has become a mature technology and urging awareness-raising on quantum safety and immediate migration.

title: ETSI/IQC Quantum Safe Cryptography Conference 2025
summary: Event page for the ETSI/IQC Quantum Safe Cryptography Conference 2025, featuring sessions on the post-quantum cryptography transition including the QUBIP and PQ-REACT projects.

title: ETSI TC ESI PQC Working Group Terms of Reference
summary: Terms of reference for the ETSI TC ESI PQC working group, whose work covers post-quantum cryptographic signatures and certificates, post-quantum public key infrastructures, and policies for post-quantum transition.

title: NIST PQC: The road ahead
summary: ETSI article featuring NIST mathematician Dustin Moody, who leads NIST's post-quantum cryptography project, on the road ahead for PQC standardisation.

title: Proposal COM(2026) 13 final (targeted amendments including mandatory PQC migration policies)
summary: Commission legislative proposal COM(2026) 13 final providing that Member States should be required to adopt policies for the migration to post-quantum cryptography (PQC).

title: Roadmap for lawful and effective access to data for law enforcement
summary: Commission roadmap on lawful and effective access to data for law enforcement, stating that deploying post-quantum cryptography (PQC) solutions and developing quantum key distribution will be crucial to safeguarding data.

title: A European Internal Security Strategy
summary: Commission communication on a European Internal Security Strategy, stating that deploying post-quantum cryptography (PQC) solutions will be crucial to safeguard sensitive communications and data at rest.

title: Commission Communication COM(2024) 81 final
summary: Commission document COM(2024) 81 final describing Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC) as a promising approach to make communications and data resistant to quantum attacks.

title: EESC Opinion on the EU's Cybersecurity Strategy (CELEX 52020AE5923)
summary: European Economic and Social Committee opinion noting the need for a transition to quantum-resistant or post-quantum cryptography and referencing the PQC standardisation process.

title: Technology as a new frontier for macroprudential policy (speech)
summary: ECB speech on technology and macroprudential policy noting that the US National Institute of Standards and Technology finalised the first post-quantum encryption standards.

title: One step ahead: protecting the cyber resilience of financial infrastructures (speech)
summary: ECB speech stating that discussing post-quantum cryptography environments within the Euro Cyber Resilience Board will help understand the opportunities and risks for financial infrastructures.

title: Pontes User Requirements Document v0.5
summary: ECB user requirements document for the Pontes initiative requiring post-quantum resilient cryptographic capabilities through crypto-agility mechanisms enabling progressive migration towards standardised post-quantum cryptography.

title: European Payments Stakeholders Group status report (24th ERPB meeting)
summary: Status report by the European Payments Stakeholders Group to the ECB's Euro Retail Payments Board, covering analysis of the announced EC programme for the post-quantum migration of sensitive EU infrastructures and its impact on the banking and payments industry. Industry stakeholder group within an ECB-convened forum, flagged for review.

title: ECSG Status Report on cards standardisation (18th ERPB meeting)
summary: European Cards Stakeholders Group status report on cards standardisation noting NIST's release of the list of post-quantum crypto-algorithms to be standardised against future quantum threats. Industry stakeholder group within an ECB-convened forum, flagged for review.

title: 2nd European Conference on PQC Migration
summary: Conference site for the 2nd European Conference on PQC Migration, addressing questions about the PQC transition with international cybersecurity experts and stakeholders. Organising institution not verifiable from the candidate data, flagged for review.

title: Recommendation on a Coordinated Implementation Roadmap for the transition to Post-Quantum Cryptography (library page)
summary: European Commission (DG CONNECT) library page for the 11 April 2024 Recommendation on a Coordinated Implementation Roadmap for the transition to Post-Quantum Cryptography, encouraging Member States to develop a comprehensive PQC adoption strategy; distinct URL from the existing EUR-Lex and 'Coordinated Implementation Roadmap' corpus entries, with download links in all 24 EU languages.

title: EUCC Guidelines on Cryptography: Agreed Cryptographic Mechanisms (Version 2)
summary: ECCG/ENISA 'Agreed Cryptographic Mechanisms' v2 (adopted mid-2025) recommending cryptographic mechanisms for ICT products submitted to EUCC certification; explicitly introduces several asymmetric post-quantum mechanisms as agreed and provides key-combiner mechanisms for hybrid key establishment combining a post-quantum KEM with a classical KEM.

title: Quantum Europe Strategy communication COM(2025) 363 final
summary: European Commission communication COM(2025) 363 final (Quantum Europe Strategy) stating that the EU and Member States are implementing the post-quantum cryptography Recommendation and have published a roadmap responding to quantum risks to communication security, alongside quantum-safe network deployment objectives; EUR-Lex HTML text distinct from the qt.eu PDF already in the corpus.

title: Participate in the public review of the new draft of 'Agreed Cryptographic Mechanisms'
summary: ENISA/EUCC news item (2 June 2026) opening public review until end of July 2026 of version 3 of the 'Agreed Cryptographic Mechanisms', the EUCC document whose v2 introduced post-quantum mechanisms; the news text itself does not spell out 'post-quantum', so flagged as a draft for review.

title: IPEN event on post-quantum cryptography: The leap to post-quantum data protection
summary: The European Data Protection Supervisor, with the Paris Lodron University of Salzburg, convened an Internet Privacy Engineering Network conference in Salzburg on 8 September 2026 on the risks quantum technologies pose to long-term confidentiality and data protection. It examines practical strategies for transitioning to post-quantum cryptography, covering current standards, implementation challenges and migration pathways.

title: European technological sovereignty and digital infrastructure - European Parliament resolution of 22 January 2026 (P10_TA(2026)0022)
summary: European Parliament own-initiative resolution on technological sovereignty and digital infrastructure, published in the Official Journal (C/2026/3697) on 5 August 2026. It explicitly calls for a coordinated EU strategy for post-quantum cryptography to protect data from future cyberthreats.

title: Cybersecurity call for proposals HORIZON-CL3-2026-02-CS-ECCC
summary: European Cybersecurity Competence Centre call under Horizon Europe closing 15 September 2026, whose third topic (EUR 15 million) funds advanced cryptographic schemes and high-assurance implementations. It solicits quantum-resistant cryptographic primitives, post-quantum entity authentication and authenticated key establishment, and formal verification tooling for post-quantum migration.

title: ETSI TS 104 145 V1.1.1 - Cyber Security (CYBER); Quantum-Safe Cryptography (QSC); Quantum-Safe Enterprise Transport Security (QSETS)
summary: ETSI Technical Specification published in June 2026 by TC CYBER's Quantum-Safe Cryptography group, defining quantum-safe enterprise transport security. It is a normative deliverable specifying how enterprise transport-layer security is made resistant to quantum attack.

title: ETSI TR 104 239-2 V1.1.1 - Quantum-Safe Cryptography (QSC); Secure Implementation Guidance for Key Encapsulation Mechanisms and Digital Signature Schemes; Part 2: ML-KEM
summary: ETSI Technical Report published in June 2026 giving secure implementation guidance for post-quantum key encapsulation and signature schemes, with this part dedicated to ML-KEM. It translates the standardised PQC primitives into implementation practice for European vendors and evaluators.

title: Wait & see is not an option: Q-day is here
summary: ETSI newsroom readout, dated 22 June 2026, of the 2026 ETSI/IQC Quantum Safe Cryptography Conference in Ottawa, attended by over 250 participants from industry, government and academia. It reports keynote conclusions on the urgency of PQC migration, the centrality of standards and interoperability, and a shortage of PQC-specialised engineers and board-level readiness.

title: Establishment of a List of External Experts in Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC) - ECCC/BUH/2026/CEI/0017
summary: Prior information notice / call for expressions of interest published on TED on 26 June 2026 by the European Cybersecurity Competence Centre to build a standing list of external post-quantum cryptography experts across the European Economic Area. It institutionalises PQC advisory capacity inside the EU's cybersecurity funding agency.

title: State of the Digital Decade 2026: Closing structural gaps and mobilising investments for 2030 and beyond (COM(2026) 288 final)
summary: Commission Communication of 17 June 2026 assessing EU digital progress, which finds Member State progress uneven on preparing for post-quantum cryptography and states a clear and urgent need to ramp up PQC transition efforts. It requires that PQC migration safeguard service continuity and be coordinated across network types, in line with the timeline in the June 2025 Coordinated Implementation Roadmap.

title: Digital Decade 2026 country report (SWD(2026) 155 final)
summary: Commission Staff Working Document of 17 June 2026 giving per-Member-State digital assessments, with numerous country-level post-quantum entries (for example Estonia's national PQC roadmap and QARC project, Latvia's quantum-resistant cryptography strategy, and a Greek HellasQCI hybrid QKD/PQC deployment for medical data). It is the Commission's country-by-country evidence base on national PQC readiness.

title: Monitoring of EU-level recommendations 2025 (SWD(2026) 156 final)
summary: Commission Staff Working Document of 17 June 2026 tracking implementation of EU-level digital recommendations, including the recommendation that Member States transition cryptosystems to post-quantum cryptography via the NIS Cooperation Group roadmap. It records that the PQC work stream is now developing sectorial guidance and that further action is needed on cross-border testing and on growing an EU ecosystem of PQC-compliant solutions.

title: ECCG Agreed Cryptographic Mechanisms - version 3 - draft for public review
summary: Working draft of version 3 of the European Cybersecurity Certification Group cryptography sub-group's Agreed Cryptographic Mechanisms, issued for public review on 2 June 2026 (review open until end July 2026). It realigns the EUCC certification cryptography baseline for the post-quantum era, removing mechanisms deprecated in 2025 and introducing an admissible-mechanisms category for gradual migration of large-scale deployments.

title: Hybridization of traditional cryptographic mechanisms with PQC - Standardisation Status
summary: ENISA report dated 30 April 2026, produced with the ECCG sub-group on cryptography, analysing the state of standardisation for hybridising traditional cryptographic mechanisms with post-quantum cryptography and mapping it against Agreed Cryptographic Mechanisms v2.0. It is explicitly not yet a recommendation but is intended to feed later ECCG recommendations on preferred hybridisation modes.

title: Proposal for a Regulation on ENISA, the European cybersecurity certification framework, and ICT supply chain security, repealing Regulation (EU) 2019/881 (Cybersecurity Act 2) - COM(2026) 11 final
summary: Commission legislative proposal of 20 January 2026 revising the Cybersecurity Act, which mandates ENISA to contribute to the development and evaluation of cryptographic algorithms, in particular post-quantum cryptography, on Commission request. It presents measures for transition to post-quantum cryptography as a means of increasing public trust in the protection of sensitive data in critical sectors.

title: Proposal for a Regulation on digital networks (Digital Networks Act) - COM(2026) 16 final
summary: Commission legislative proposal of 21 January 2026 recasting the EU electronic communications framework, which states that the transition to post-quantum cryptography is necessary for next-generation secure communications in critical network segments. It requires that the security of sensitive data and critical infrastructure be reinforced by ensuring timely transition to PQC alongside integration of quantum-based systems and EuroQCI.

title: Commission Notice - The 2026 annual Union work programme for European standardisation (C/2026/1695)
summary: Commission Notice published in the Official Journal on 19 March 2026 setting EU standardisation priorities, with Action 2 dedicated to standards driving quantum technology development and the implementation of post-quantum cryptography protocols. It announces that the Commission will request European standards and standardisation deliverables for validation and transposition of PQC in support of Commission Recommendation (EU) 2024/1101.

title: Deployment of a European testing infrastructure for the transition to PQC in different usage domains
summary: European Cybersecurity Competence Centre open contract notice on TED (published 5 February 2026, superseding notice 849943-2025 of December 2025) procuring a European post-quantum cryptography testing infrastructure across the European Economic Area, with an estimated value of EUR 25 million and tenders due 6 March 2026. It establishes independent EU-level PQC testing and evaluation capacity across usage domains.

title: Post-Quantum Cryptography, the Journey so far and the Challenges Ahead (JRC144095, EUR 40573)
summary: Joint Research Centre technical report by Chenu and Sportiello, published by the Publications Office of the European Union in 2025, reviewing the post-quantum cryptography standardisation journey and the outstanding migration challenges. It is the Commission's in-house scientific evidence base on PQC, providing advisory research support to EU policymaking rather than binding recommendations.

title: EU Roadmap on Post-Quantum Cryptography - Survey feedback
summary: Commission library page, published 2 September 2026, reporting the results of the NIS Cooperation Group's 11 August to 29 September 2025 survey on its Coordinated Implementation Roadmap for the transition to PQC (97 submissions). It notes that respondents valued the roadmap's timelines and risk-based approach, and that the Group produced an FAQ in response to requests for clarification.

title: ECCC Digital Europe Cybersecurity Work Programme 2025-2027 - Consolidated Amendment 2
summary: ECCC Governing Board work programme for Digital Europe cybersecurity funding, consolidated with Amendment 2 adopted in October 2025 (GB Decision 2025/15). It allocates funding to new technologies and the post-quantum transition, with dedicated topics on a European PQC testing infrastructure, transition to post-quantum PKIs and migration of Cyber Hubs to PQC.

title: Annual report 2025 of the Interinstitutional Cybersecurity Board (IICB)
summary: Council document 5167/26 of 9 January 2026 transmitting the IICB's 2025 annual report. It records that in June 2025 the IICB began exchanges between Union entities on post-quantum cryptography, mandated the Commission to lead that work, and includes a section on a common approach to PQC.

title: Access to data for law enforcement: Digital forensics
summary: European Parliamentary Research Service briefing (July 2025) on digital forensics, one of three key areas the High-Level Group on access to data for law enforcement identified. A short section on quantum computing notes the threat to traditional cryptography and refers in passing to the 23 June 2025 roadmap by Member States and the Commission for the coordinated transition to post-quantum cryptography.

title: Regulation establishing European Competitiveness Fund (ECF), including specific programme for defence research and innovation - Partial general approach
summary: Council General Secretariat note 10491/26 of 12 June 2026 transmitting the text put to the General Affairs Council on 16 June 2026 for a partial general approach on the proposed ECF Regulation (interinstitutional file 2025/0555 (COD)); it is a negotiating text, not adopted law. It lists post-quantum cryptography among the cybersecurity cross-cutting areas.

title: EU allocates €145.5 million to boost European cybersecurity, including for hospitals and healthcare providers
summary: Commission news item of 12 June 2025 announcing €145.5 million across two cybersecurity funding calls. The Horizon Europe call (€90.5 million) supports advanced cybersecurity tools including post-quantum cryptography.
